subject: MAP: unit-econ deep check — KV-cache prefetch & microbatch assumptions

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: MAP: unit-econ deep check — KV-cache prefetch & microbatch assumptions

Hi Anita / Sam,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I’m attaching a lightweight MAP draft focused specifically on the unit-economics checkpoints we agreed are required for close: tokens/$ baseline, cache hit-rate assumptions (prefix & KV), microbatching latency tradeoffs, and where we need PulseCare sign-off versus data handoff.

Key asks in this message:
- Please review the tab labeled "Econ assumptions" in the attached MAP_v2_unit_econ.xlsx. The baseline tokens-per-call and avg tokens/session are our current best guesses; markers in column G are where we need your traffic profile to validate.
- Two caching numbers we used: prefix cache hit 25% (steady-state) and KV-cache warmup to 60% after 48 hours of traffic. If PulseCare has historical session re-use or repeat-prefix stats please send a sample.
- Microbatching: we modeled microbatch sizes of 1/4/8 with batching window of 10ms. That produces the token-cost delta in the prefetched sim results (prefetch-sim-results.csv). We’ll need to align on acceptable 95th latency for search/assist flows before we lock batching.

Proposed MAP milestones (short):
1) Today (Jun 9): RW sends MAP draft + sim results (attached) — ACTION: PulseCare to send 48h traffic sample or at minimum a 24h sample (anonymized).
2) Jun 11: RW returns updated sim with PulseCare traffic; propose final token-cost range and suggested cache/batch config.
3) Jun 16: Joint sign-off on unit-econ assumptions + small paper contract amendment for burst/billing gates.

Attachments: MAP_v2_unit_econ.xlsx (workbook), prefetch-sim-results.csv (simulation export).

If you prefer, I can drop the specific sim table into a shared Drive link instead of attachments.

Thanks — Vivek

Vivek —

Thanks for the thorough MAP draft. A few clarifying questions from our side before we pull the traffic sample: 

1) For the prefix cache hit assumption (25%), can you share what definition you used for a "repeat prefix"? Is that repeated full prompt strings or identical user IDs issuing the same flow?
2) The KV-cache warmup to 60% after 48 hours — what cold-start pattern did you simulate (e.g., all users cold at T0 vs progressive rollout)?
3) On microbatching: our product team is wary of anything that increases p95 above 250ms for interactive assist. Can you show the p95 impact column-by-column in the spreadsheet?

We can provide a 48-hour anonymized traffic sample. I’m attaching our internal sample extract — it has timestamps and anonymized session IDs. If you need additional metrics (repeat user flag or flow type) call that out and we’ll try to include.

Anita
Director, Platform — PulseCare

Subject: Re: MAP: unit-econ deep check — KV-cache prefetch & microbatch assumptions

Anita — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the sample. Short answers first, then a plan: 

1) Repeat-prefix definition: in our sim we used identical prompt stem (first 40 tokens) within the same session and across sessions from the same anonymized user_id. We’ll add an alternative metric using 20-token prefix to the workbook so you can see sensitivity.
2) KV-cache warmup pattern: the sim used progressive warm-up (10% of unique sessions per hour), which better reflects a staged roll-out rather than a single big-bang. We’ll re-run an "all-cold" scenario and add both curves.
3) p95 impact: see sheet "Latency by batch" (tab) — I highlighted microbatch windows 5/10/20ms and the corresponding p95. Quick summary from current sim: microbatch window=10ms with batch target 4 increases p95 from 180ms -> 220ms on our sampled traffic; batching target 8 moves p95 to ~260ms.

Proposed immediate next steps (short timeline):
- Today (Jun 9 EOD): RW to ingest PulseCare sample and produce variant sim outputs (20-token prefix sensitivity + all-cold vs progressive warmup).
- Jun 10 (AM): RW sends updated sim + a short one-page summary called "Unit-econ signoff checklist" for PulseCare engineering & finance to review.
- Jun 12: Joint readout — confirm final tokens/$ range and gating thresholds for billing (burst cap, 95th latency exception).

We’ll also add a billing milestone to the MAP: an "Ops validation window" (14 days) where costs are reconciled against simulated tokens-per-dollar and caching performance; if variance >15% we default to a pre-agreed mitigation (throttling or model tier fallback) while we adjust billing.

I’ll attach the updated sim exports to the Drive link and push the one-pager to the MAP folder.

Cheers — Vivek
